title: File:Mike Johnson and the Tebows, 2024.jpg
desc:
From Johnson's Facebook.
"Kelly and I enjoyed meeting with Tim Tebow and his wife Demi-Leigh Tebow last week. They are doing tremendous work through the Tim Tebow Foundation to fight human trafficking and exploitation. They’re bringing faith, hope, and love to those in their darkest hour."
